summary.text: Co-captain of the Halizones beside Odius, from Alybe where silver is born — a namesake of Epistrophus son of Iphitus the Phocian and of the warrior Achilles slew at Lyrnessus.

story.text: Homer names Epistrophus with Odius at the head of the Halizones who came from afar, from Alybe, in the muster at Troy — distinct from the Phocian captain son of Iphitus and from the son of Evenus whom Achilles laid low when he sacked Lyrnessus.
